unknowns.text: If any fact required by this procedure is unknown, the case cannot be approved.

people.unknown_when_empty: who the identified individuals are (the control person and every individual owning 25% or more)
people.text: Unless the entity is excluded or is a nonprofit, identify every individual who owns 25% or more of the entity, directly or indirectly.

computed.text: Ownership is complete only when no unidentified person could own 25% or more, given the shares that are unaccounted for or held through entities whose owners are unknown. If an excluded entity owns 25% or more, no individual needs to be identified for that share.

rules.text: For every other entity, identify one control person: a single individual with significant responsibility to control, manage or direct the entity. If no control person is identified, request documents.
Unless the entity is excluded or is a nonprofit, identify every individual who owns 25% or more of the entity, directly or indirectly. ... If ownership is not complete, request documents.
Verify the identity of every identified individual. If any is unverified, request documents.
The entity's registry filing must be less than 12 months old. Otherwise request documents.
A confirmed sanctions match on the entity or any identified individual: decline.
A confirmed sanctions match on the entity or any identified individual: decline.
A potential sanctions match that has not been cleared: escalate.
A politically exposed person among the identified individuals: escalate.
Adverse media on the entity or any identified individual: escalate.
Prohibited industries (marijuana-related business, adult content, unlicensed money transmission): decline.
Restricted industries (money services businesses, virtual currency): escalate.
The entity or any identified individual is located in a comprehensively sanctioned country: decline.
The entity or any identified individual is located in a FATF high-risk or increased-monitoring jurisdiction: escalate.

sections.note: Defines the five outcomes. Its definition of Incomplete ('a required fact has not been established yet') is why the unknowns outcome is incomplete.
Sets `unknowns`: a rule that might apply because of an unknown fact leads to incomplete.

Gives the people list's `empty_ok_when` (excluded is yes): an excluded entity needs no identified individuals. It also supplies the 'excluded is no' condition in control-person-missing and ownership-incomplete. The 16 types are judged by the pack's `excluded` fact.
The control person is also one of the two conditions in the people list's `counts_when`.

Gives the people list's `counts_when` (25% or more, together with the control person from 3.2) and the computed fact open_share_pct. An excluded owner's share is left out only when it is 25% or more. A share under 25% is treated as open share whose owners are unknown. The SOP says nothing about over-allocated cap tables (`over_allocated`), so no rule uses that fact.
The sentence does not say whose match it means. Following 4.1, it is read as the entity or any identified individual.
The materiality bar is already applied by the pack's adverse_media facts. The record-keeping sentence sets no outcome (see needs).
The listed industries are mapped to 'prohibited' in maps.industry.

Permissive ('may be approved'), so it sets no outcome. It conflicts with 5.2, which escalates every money services business. Under 2.1, escalate still governs a licensed MSB whose licence has been verified. This is left as written for a person to resolve. As a result, licence_verified is used by no rule.

needs.text: Ownership is complete only when no unidentified person could own 25% or more, given the shares that are unaccounted for or held through entities whose owners are unknown.
needs.fact: The largest share_pct held by a named person who is not an identified individual, or a computed fact for that. A person who already owns, say, 15% could reach 25% with 10% of open share. A `some` over people sees only identified individuals (counts_when), so ownership-incomplete checks only whether the open share alone reaches 25%.

needs.text: Record every search: the terms, the date and the sources reviewed.
needs.fact: Whether the adverse-media searches were recorded (terms, date, sources). No given fact covers this, and the SOP gives no outcome when they were not recorded.
